svg.aria-label: Game developer finishing a B.S. in Computer Science at ASU in May 2027. My jam games placed #9 of 2,253 in the Brackeys Game Jam and 2nd at the AZ Game Cup, and I am turning my roguelike AtOMoC SHeLiS into a Steam release. At UNOMi I build animation plugins for Maya, Blender, Unreal and Cinema 4D and made our markerless motion capture 2.8x faster at the same accuracy. I also keyframe by hand and train AI agents to play games.
